review_comments.body: ⚠️ Quality: Boolean min/max as 0/1 is an unrecorded choice, unlike default profiler The PR chooses how a boolean column's min/max shows up in the column profile that gets sent to the server. The description calls this "one of the options listed in the issue". With this change, Trino's stored-statistics path reports `min=0`/`max=1` for boolean columns. The default profiler does the opposite: `Min.fn` returns `None` for any type that is neither quantifiable nor datetime, so booleans get no min/max. The same column can therefore get different profile values depending on whether stored statistics are enabled. That is a contract the UI and other connectors have to agree with, and nothing in `docs/decisions/` covers it. There are two ways to resolve this: - Match the existing profiler: return `None` for `'true'`/`'false'`. This still fixes the `ValidationError`. - Keep 0/1 and add a record stating: "Profilers report a boolean column's min and max as 0 and 1 (false/true); the Trino stored-statistics source and the default metrics agree on this." The default metrics would need to be aligned with that rule. **Drop boolean bounds so the result matches the default profiler (which gives no min/max for booleans) and the table no longer fails validation.:** ```` if lowered in ("true", "false"): # Default Min/Max metrics do not compute bounds for booleans return None ```` ✅ Fixed by `@pcbeingused333` in 1a8e817 Reply for a change | Was this helpful? React with 👍 / 👎

**Missing license header.** The new Python test file starts without a license header. The repository guide requires Python files under `ingestion/` to use the Collate Community License 1.0 header copied from a sibling file. Add that header before the module docstring. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/open-metadata/openmetadata/blob/main/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
